faq.q: How much does Benedum Law charge?
faq.a: Benedum Law publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Benedum Law offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Benedum Law publishes a free initial consultation.

faq.q: Where does Benedum Law have offices?
faq.a: Benedum Law publishes one office, in Philadelphia. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Benedum Law?
faq.a: Benedum Law names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.
